content.what_it_is: Fixed-form Fortran main program that declares 1024-by-512 coordinate, depth, obstacle, and auxiliary grids (L1-L4); builds a centered 2 m coordinate grid shifted 250 m in y (L18-L23); constructs an elliptical sinusoidal shoal (L33-L63); constructs a flat/slope/channel/basin depth field (L72-L90) and takes its cellwise minimum with the shoal (L93-L99); initializes and inserts a hard-coded two-row breakwater plus a radial depth taper (L101-L130); and writes x, y, two depth grids, obstacle flags, and breakwater values to six formatted text files (L133-L172).
entities: m and n integer parameters at L1
real arrays x, y, cori, dep, dep_swan at L2
real arrays h, breakwater, dep_brk at L3
implicit-real scalars depmax, depmin, slope, dx, dy, y_shift, breakwater_width, breakwater_length, y_break, x_break at L6-L15
implicit-real scalars width_surf, width_inlet, ramp_channel, rlength_inlet, dep_inlet, dep_basin, flat at L25-L31
implicit-real scalars a_in, a_out, b_in, b_out, height, shoal_sitting, pi at L34-L40
implicit-integer loop indices i, j, ii, jj at L18-L19 and L120-L121
implicit-real working scalars r, phi, r_out, r_in, dis, rate, d at L45-L57 and L122-L124

equations.ref: squared outer ellipse radius across L47-L49, square-rooted at L50
squared inner ellipse radius across L51-L53, square-rooted at L54
cosine inlet channel floor across L81-L82
distance to each hard-coded breakwater seed

calls: sqrt at L45, L50, L54, and L122
sin and cos at L48-L49, L52-L53, L58, and L81-L82
write at L135, L140, L147, L153, L160, and L166
close at L137, L142, L149, L155, L162, and L168
unresolved: Range defect across L21, L76-L87, and L97: for 0<y<100 the slope branch at L77 produces negative dep. Outside abs(x)<=150 the channel branch at L80-L83 does not replace it, and the basin branch begins only at y>=100 at L85. The later min(dep,h) at L97 preserves the negative value. depmin=0.002 at L7 is never applied, so a substantial grid region is emitted with negative depth.

Dead configuration/interface mismatch: slope, breakwater_length, y_break, x_break, width_inlet, and depmin are assigned at L7-L8, L13-L15, and L26 but never used. Breakwater placement instead uses literal index ranges 412:612 and 300:301 at L111-L112. With the coordinate transform at L20-L21 those rows lie near y=-163 to -161 rather than the configured y_break=-150.

Dimension parameter hazard: m and n are presented as parameters at L1, but obstacle loops unconditionally access i=412:612 and j=300:301 at L111-L125. Reducing either parameter below those maxima causes out-of-bounds access; no range check connects the interface values to the hard-coded indices.

Declared arrays cori and dep_swan at L2 are never assigned or written, and breakwater_length/width_inlet/slope controls are similarly inactive, leaving their intended outputs or geometry effects unresolved from this file.

The output loops use i as the record index and j as the inner list at L134-L167, so each file is m rows by n columns despite arrays being declared (m,n); the consuming orientation is not declared in this file.
